They’re not just surviving; they’re thriving by owning their commerce infrastructure. No subscriptions. No platform lock-in. Full data ownership. For creators in Ghana, Nigeria, Kenya, and beyond who face similar restrictions, this model isn’t just inspiring—it’s actionable. Here’s how it works, why it matters, and how you can deploy it today.

content.text: What This Actually Is and Why It Matters

This is sovereign commerce infrastructure—a complete stack of tools that let you sell digital products without relying on third-party platforms. It’s built on open-source and free-tier services like GitHub Pages, Cloudflare Workers, and Supabase. Payments are processed via NOWPayments, which supports 300+ cryptocurrencies with a flat 0.5% fee and no KYC. The architecture is designed to be owned, not rented. Once deployed, it’s yours. No one can shut it down, restrict your access, or take a cut of your earnings. For creators in regions where Stripe and PayPal are unavailable, this isn’t just a technical solution—it’s economic sovereignty. It’s built to withstand currency collapse, payment rejection, and financial isolation. It’s not a hack; it’s infrastructure.
How the Architecture Works Under the Hood

The stack is simple but powerful. Your store is hosted on GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages—both free and globally distributed. Backend logic runs on Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script, which handle order processing and payment verification. Orders are stored in Supabase or Google Sheets, and product files are delivered via Google Drive or Cloudflare R2. NOWPayments handles crypto payments, firing a webhook the moment a transaction confirms on-chain. This triggers the backend to deliver the product instantly. The entire system is automated, secure, and scalable. You don’t need to manage servers or databases. It’s designed to work out of the box, with no ongoing fees or dependencies on COREMERCH or any other platform. You own the code. You own the data. You own the revenue.
Who This Is Built For and Why

This is built for digital creators who sell ebooks, courses, templates, fonts, presets, beats, plugins, software, and other digital products. If you’re in a region where Stripe, PayPal, Gumroad, or Paddle are unavailable or severely restricted, this is for you. It’s for creators who want to own their infrastructure, not rent it. It’s for those who value sovereignty over convenience. It’s for people who understand that relying on third-party platforms is a single point of failure. This isn’t a solution for everyone—it requires a basic understanding of how to deploy code and manage a GitHub repository. But if you’re willing to invest the time, the payoff is complete control over your commerce stack. No more waiting for platforms to approve your account or currency. No more fees eating into your profits. Just you, your customers, and the products you create.
Sovereign commerce infrastructure removes geographic barriers entirely.
The Components That Make It Work Together

The stack is composed of carefully selected components, each serving a specific purpose. GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages provide static hosting for your store. Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script handle backend logic, from order processing to file delivery. Supabase or Google Sheets store order data, and Google Drive or Cloudflare R2 serve as the file delivery mechanism. NOWPayments processes crypto payments, supporting networks like BSC, Solana, and TRON for low transaction fees. Each component is chosen for its reliability, cost-effectiveness, and ease of use. They integrate seamlessly, creating a cohesive system that requires no ongoing maintenance. The Complete Builder Kit includes all the blueprints and templates you need to deploy this stack in hours, not weeks. It’s the fastest way to go from zero to a fully operational, sovereign online store.
How to Use This Knowledge to Deploy Today

Start by understanding your requirements. How many products do you want to sell? What cryptocurrencies will you accept? Once you’re clear, choose the stack that fits your needs. The Sovereign Starter Stack is ideal for beginners, while the Edge Commerce Stack offers advanced features like SPF/DKIM/DMARC configuration. If you want full documentation and source code, the Complete Builder Kit is your best option. Deployment is straightforward. Clone the repository, configure your payment gateway, load your products, and deploy. The process is documented step-by-step, with no guesswork required. Once live, your store is fully automated. Customers pay in crypto, and the product is delivered instantly. You focus on creating; the infrastructure handles the rest. It’s commerce, simplified and sovereign.
How can creators in Africa sell digital products to international buyers?

Venezuelan creators are using blockchain-based payments to sell digital products without relying on Stripe or PayPal. They deploy sovereign commerce infrastructure using free tools like GitHub Pages, Cloudflare Workers, and Supabase, combined with NOWPayments for crypto processing. This architecture gives them full data ownership, no platform fees, and resistance to financial restrictions. It’s a model that works anywhere traditional payment platforms are unavailable or restricted.
NOWPayments processes 300+ cryptocurrencies with a flat 0.5% fee.

If you’re ready to deploy this architecture, the Complete Builder Kit provides all the blueprints, templates, and documentation you need. It’s the fastest way to go from zero to a fully operational, sovereign online store. No subscriptions. No platform lock-in. Just infrastructure you own.
Your Deployment Checklist

1. Choose your stack: Sovereign Starter Stack, Edge Commerce Stack, or Complete Builder Kit. 2. Clone the repository from GitHub. 3. Configure NOWPayments for your preferred cryptocurrencies. 4. Load your products into the system. 5. Deploy to GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages. 6. Test end-to-end to ensure payments and file delivery work seamlessly. 7. Promote your store and start selling.
Frequently Asked Questions
Can I use this if I’m not a developer?
Yes, but you’ll need basic technical skills to deploy the stack. The Complete Builder Kit includes detailed documentation and templates to guide you through the process.
What cryptocurrencies can I accept?
NOWPayments supports 300+ cryptocurrencies. Recommended networks for low fees include BSC, Solana, and TRON.
Do I need to pay ongoing fees?
No. The stack uses free-tier services, and NOWPayments charges a flat 0.5% fee per transaction. There are no subscriptions or hidden costs.
Can COREMERCH access my data or store?
No. Once deployed, the infrastructure is entirely yours. COREMERCH has no access to your data, store, or revenue.
How do I handle customer support?
The stack is automated, but you can integrate email or messaging tools for customer inquiries. The Edge Commerce Stack includes SPF/DKIM/DMARC configuration for secure email communication.
